name: ETH VolFavorite wide (top 40%)
description: ETH VolFavorite v2 with a looser entry bar: buy the favourite late in the window when implied vol is in the top 40% of its ratio to the forecast, instead of the top 30%. More trades, each a little weaker.
hypothesis: eth-volfav2 enters only on the top 30% of implied/forecast vol ratios (+2.2c/ct walk-forward). Signals in the next band (30-40%) are weaker but, if ETH's market overprices vol broadly, still worth more than the ~1.3c taker fee; lowering the bar to the top 40% should then add total dollars even as c/contract falls. Wrong if total PnL over the walk-forward is not higher than eth-volfav2's, or the added band's own trades are flat or negative after fees.
next: full walk-forward; compare total PnL and the added band vs eth-volfav2; lockbox (Sep 1+) if it adds money.
